name: Bedhead
lede: Brothers Matt and Bubba Kadane led Bedhead out of Dallas with three guitars and slow, methodical songs, three albums of them on Trance Syndicate. They quit in 1998, a few months after Transaction de Novo.

facts.h: Fort Worth kids lined up with pillows and blankets
facts.p: That's how fans waited outside Mad Hatters, the club where Bedhead first took off, says Josh Robertson, the band's de facto manager.

facts.h: 4-songEP19:10 was cut on one microphone in an Oak Cliff church
facts.p: Engineer Mark Elliott set the band up in the Kessler Church in Dallas. Once they started, he says, "it took 19 minutes to record."

facts.h: A hair-product company had taken the name, and a Dallas one
facts.p: Matt Kadane put the 1998 breakup down to his disillusionment with the name "Bedhead" and the practical difficulties of keeping the band running.
